SubnetIdentitiesV3.description: The first decentralized & trustless liquidity and execution engine for prop firms and traders
SubnetIdentitiesV3.additional: Vanta Network is the first decentralized, trustless liquidity and execution engine for prop firms and traders. It live-trades top-performing miners who deposit alpha for funding, rewards them based on verifiable performance, and uses profits to buy back alpha, creating a transparent, risk-adjusted, and incentive-aligned trading ecosystem.
